choices.text: Record it raw. All of it.
Run a PEERHOOD check: isolate the pattern.

scenes.text:
Camp Halcyon, dusk. Your field spectrometer — the one you calibrated yourself, the one that has never once lied to you — is [b]singing[/b].

Not beeping. Singing. A four-note phrase, repeating, and the fourth note is shaped exactly like your name, {name}.

The needle for the largest fragment trembles north-northwest. The song gets louder when you walk toward it.
scenes.title: THE SPECTROMETER SINGS

choices.text: Take the recording down to the crash field.

scenes.text:
[b]PERFECT.[/b] You isolate the phrase in under a minute: four notes, prime-number spacing, and a fifth note hiding [i]between[/i] the others that only appears when you stop listening for it.

It's a handshake protocol. Whatever fell here is still introducing itself.
scenes.title: THE FIFTH NOTE
